G001.target_statement: Find a new place to live when moving to a new neighborhood or country, by searching on the internet with house-hunting web apps.
G001.label: direct
G001.rationale: 原句明确以搬家为由需要找新住处，并说明用网络与 web app 的方式；主体、情境、目的与选定方式一致，强度为通常做法。

G002.target_statement: Choose the neighborhood or area to search in before starting a house search.
G002.label: direct
G002.rationale: 原句先选街区/地点再按关键词搜索，动作与先后顺序明确，未附加例外或强度弱化。

G003.target_statement: Identify the listing websites that are most popular or most used in the target area, especially when the area is in another country.
G003.label: direct
G003.rationale: 原句明确想了解当地最常用网站，并说明关键词搜索是达成手段；popular/most used 为原话强度，未夸大。

G004.target_statement: Find neighborhoods where listings that fit my budget and requirements are clustered.
G004.label: direct
G004.rationale: 原句把“预算与要求相符的房源聚集在某街区”作为选街区的一种方式；主体、对象与条件一致。

G005.target_statement: Get recommendations on places from people who live in the target country.
G005.label: direct
G005.rationale: 原句把询问当地居住者的推荐作为选街区方式之一，意图明确；未声称对方必然给建议。

G006.target_statement: Pick a neighborhood close to my job or college when I have one.
G006.label: direct
G006.rationale: 原句以“如果有特定工作或就读学校”为条件，说明通常会选靠近该区域的街区；保留 usually 的可让步强度。

G007.target_statement: Search listings by size or bedroom count within a budget limit.
G007.label: direct
G007.rationale: 原句明确按面积/卧室数并带预算上限搜索；条件与方式一致，未附加阈值。

G008.target_statement: Filter the retrieved options down by secondary criteria such as amenities, extra features, or how good the place looks.
G008.label: direct
G008.rationale: 原句在得到许多选项后用 amenities、额外特征、外观等“不太重要”的条件继续筛选；动作独立且有依据。

G009.target_statement: Contact the providers of the shortlisted places and narrow the options by how fast and how completely they respond.
G009.label: direct
G009.rationale: 原句明确筛选后进入沟通，并以回复速度、信息完整度影响选择；联系为核心动作，缩小选项为预期结果。

G010.target_statement: Reach a provider who does not answer through the app by finding the place's name, location or website and contacting them by email or phone.
G010.label: direct
G010.rationale: 受访者明确在站内无回应时改用邮件/电话，并说明先查明名称、地图位置或网址；触发条件（无回应）保留。

G011.target_statement: Keep the conversation with providers outside the listing apps, using the apps only to discover places.
G011.label: direct
G011.rationale: 原句直接陈述其稳定做法（平台只用于发现房源、沟通都在站外）并说明不信任站内沟通；目标按维持现状表述，未扩大为“永不使用站内沟通”，若读作纯过去行为则应降为 insufficient。

G012.target_statement: See when the listing information was last updated.
G012.label: direct
G012.rationale: 多处原句明确提出想看最后更新时间，并说明用于判断信息是否过期；强度为强烈愿望（would really love），未编造精度要求。

G013.target_statement: See a timeline of the next steps and what to expect after sending a request, including what happens if it fails.
G013.label: direct
G013.rationale: 原句要求看到下一步时间线以及失败时会怎样，另一处要求知道对方何时回复、接下来是什么；条件与内容一致。

G014.target_statement: Contact a provider with minimal information instead of filling a long form in which every field is required.
G014.label: direct
G014.rationale: 原句说明所有字段必填、只想简短沟通不想写自定义消息，并因此跳过站内请求；期望是低信息量即可联系，未扩展到其他渠道。

G015.target_statement: Share my personal information only after both sides have confirmed availability and interest.
G015.label: direct
G015.rationale: 原句明确信息可在双方确认可租且本人有意愿之后再提供，并称此前无必要提供全部信息；条件与主体一致。

G016.target_statement: See the few matching units listed with their specifications and add the chosen one to a shortlist, e-commerce style.
G016.label: direct
G016.rationale: 原句以“若有三套符合规格的房源”为例，要求列出规格并提供类似加入购物车的操作；示例情境保留为条件，未固化数量。

G017.target_statement: Compare three or four shortlisted options on a single page by their main features.
G017.label: direct
G017.rationale: 原句明确想收藏 3-4 个选项并在同一页面同时看主要特征，另一处再次提出对比功能；数量与对象一致。

G018.target_statement: Find my saved options from the nav bar or the first level of the menu.
G018.label: direct
G018.rationale: 原句明确收藏入口应在导航栏或菜单第一层，并说明现在找不到收藏位置；位置要求为原话，未自行指定具体控件。

G019.target_statement: Search inside an area drawn on the map instead of only by neighborhood name.
G019.label: direct
G019.rationale: 原句明确喜欢地图画圈选区，并说明比按街区名搜索更灵活；属对已提供功能的偏好性要求，理由为原文。

G020.target_statement: See reviews from people who lived in the place so that listings feel more trusted.
G020.label: direct
G020.rationale: 原句明确喜欢评论功能，并说明评论让房源更可信、信息更集中；因果关系为受访者自述。

G021.target_statement: Avoid extra unknown buttons and steps whose outcome I cannot tell when searching on a site.
G021.label: direct
G021.rationale: 原句明确不喜欢不知道会导向何处的按钮与冗长未知流程，并因此离开网站；属避免型意图，未扩大到所有按钮。

G022.target_statement: Search and use the full functionality without registering, with an account optional.
G022.label: direct
G022.rationale: 原句明确注册/登录应为可选而非必需，并希望直接开始搜索看到全部功能；强度为 should not be required。

G023.target_statement: Filter listings by price range, beds and baths, home type, move-in date, pets or utilities, without being forced to fill every filter.
G023.label: direct
G023.rationale: 原句列举价格、卧室/卫浴、房型、入住日期、宠物、水电等筛选，并明确喜欢筛选可选、不强制填满；维度与强度保留。

G024.target_statement: Also see, when a filter is applied, the listings whose owner did not specify that attribute.
G024.label: direct
G024.rationale: 原句明确希望有选项把未标注该属性的房源一并纳入，并可选择只看已确认；担心漏掉合适房源为依据。

G025.target_statement: Get an overview of the price ranges and available options in an area I do not know yet.
G025.label: direct
G025.rationale: 原句说明需要知道有哪些选项与价格区间，并称网站聚合信息能给出概览；目的明确，未编造指标精度。

G026.target_statement: Have the site require owners to photograph listings in a standard format (sunlight, specific angles) so that pictures are more trustworthy.
G026.label: direct
G026.rationale: 原句以 maybe 提出网站应规定照片格式（光线、角度）以增加信任；保留建议强度，未升级为强制要求。

G027.target_statement: Keep all housing communication on the listing platform when the process is clear and fast.
G027.label: direct
G027.rationale: 原句以“流程清晰且快速”为条件，表示愿意在站内与房东沟通并把全部沟通集中在一处；条件保留，未去掉条件。
